newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Hylsamex started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Hylsamex started as buy.

text.p: Credit Lyonnais Securities said on Monday that it had initiated coverage of steel maker Hylsamex with a buy recommedation.
-- "Hylsamex is recognized as one of the most efficient and profitable steel manufacturers in Latin America," analyst Harald Liberge wrote.
-- "However, the low level of liquidity of its shares, coupled with investors' reluctance to invest in Mexico and its steel sector, have so far resulted in a low share price," he wrote.
-- He said the shares are attractive at current prices, and that Hylsamex is in a favourable position to take advantage of expected growth of the Mexican economy during the next two years.
-- Hylsamex closed Friday at 38.30 pesos on the Mexico City Stock Exchange and was not traded today.
